name: ModelVariant165_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant165_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (particles rise from one of the slot's parts, pulse around their targets facing a point next to the other slot, gather onto that point and burst out again behind a glow, a ring and a fading screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the particle targets, builds the ring and glow points, packs five texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the particles have gathered, 1 once, then 0 and 2 after the burst ends; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
